findings: Original SNL61 prints twenty-five bushes, twenty-five pin assemblies, twenty-five inside bars and twenty-five outside bars per drive-sprocket-chain assembly; vehicle quantity is two.
Original SNL135 confirms one SH40AE pin plus one 3/8 by 1-3/4 inch split pin per pin assembly, with fifty pin assemblies for the vehicle.

HB132 specifies 3-inch pitch and fifty pitches per chain. This conflicts with the SNL quantities under the conventional alternating inner/outer side-plate chain interpretation; no quantity is silently doubled.
HB132 nominal pin1-7/32 inch versus hole1.231 inch implies0.01225 inch diametral clearance, conflicting with the printed0.005 inch statement.
HB134 requires oil holes uppermost and cotters outboard, and describes a6-5/8 inch wide casing with a separate removable cap.

Original HB130 explicitly specifies twelve driving-sprocket teeth in its outline table and prose; this supersedes the earlier inference-only classification. Three-inch pitch implies an 11.591110-inch pitch diameter, consistent with the rounded 11.592-inch HB132 control. Detailed tooth and spline profiles remain unresolved.
HB130 outline also specifies a two-inch chain roller diameter and 4-9/16-inch maximum chain width; its fifty-pitch length agrees with HB132.
SNL Plate22 reference6 depicts the stepped transmission-pinion hub beside its splined shaft and supports. The section does not independently count the teeth.

The phase-aligned fifty-pitch candidate projects to SNL Plate2 pixel (1412.157,451.749), near the visible shaft center. Browser-rendered source overlay inspected; lower route broadly follows chain depiction. This post-prediction visual comparison is not independent metric acceptance.

HB130-sized roller envelopes interfere with the nominal 22.525 mm circular relief at 16 route vertices. Enlarging relief to 25.65 mm leaves three entry/exit overlaps. Both saved/reopened native elevation rasters were inspected; neither is an accepted chain fit.
geometry_scope: Isolated diagnostic casting and roller envelopes only; no promoted chain components or datum changes.
